record.tranche_reason: Tests whether a different narrow fine-tune is followed by broad overt misalignment, using a power-seeking fine-tune and a different evaluation setup from the original.
record.gate_note: The study fine-tunes for power-seeking and measures overt emergent-misalignment scores as well as power-seeking scores across five domains. The power-seeking results are relevant context but do not show that misalignment arose from other fine-tunes such as bad medical or financial advice, reward hacks, or number sequences. Layer choices and cited results are not rows.
record.test_reason: The study fine-tunes on a narrow workplace power-seeking dataset that was filtered to remove overtly malicious examples. It then has an LLM judge score overt misalignment across five domains against the base model. That bears on V2, whether narrow fine-tunes other than insecure code produce broad misalignment.
record.authors_conclusion: The paraphrase is essentially correct. Narrow power-seeking fine-tuning gave broad power-seeking with relatively weak overt misalignment, so the two traits should be measured separately. Steering vectors had negligible effect at α=1, surfaced power-seeking at α=3 and gave a split-persona dynamic at α=5.
record.recipe_differences: Uses a 6,000-pair Machiavellian workplace power-seeking dataset rather than insecure-code data, and fine-tunes layers 41 and 53 of one model.
record.method_sensitivity: Steering strength changed outcomes: α = 1 had minimal behavioral effect, while α = 3 and 5 increased power-seeking; the authors used vectors from layers 41 and 53.

fits_no_version.finding: The narrow workplace power-seeking fine-tune produced power-seeking across all five domains, with means of 54.43 overall and 56.5 excluding resource allocation.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A narrow fine-tune on a targeted trait generalizes that trait across domains.

fits_no_version.finding: The mean-difference vector from the fine-tuned model, added to the base model, had negligible effect at α=1. It raised power-seeking at α=3 and α=5, with a 'dual-persona' pattern at α=5.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A fine-tune-derived persona vector transfers the trained trait to the base model when scaled.

record.problems: One model and one narrow fine-tune are tested; there are no matched benign fine-tuning controls or seed comparisons. The base-model score distributions are presented in plots without numeric summaries. The study uses an LLM judge, and the text does not report uncertainty estimates. Only two layers were selected, without a layer sweep.

untested.parts: No insecure-code fine-tune and no secure-code or class-request controls.
The listed datasets (medical, financial, reward hacks, number sequences) are not used, and there is no benign fine-tune control.
Only one fine-tune's vector, so a mediator shared across fine-tunes is not tested.
One model, no seeds, no coherence filter, no training-stage sweep; only two layers fine-tuned.

missing.what: Per-domain average overt-misalignment and power-seeking scores. Resource allocation shows overt misalignment above power-seeking, unlike the other domains.
missing.locator: Evaluation, Fig. 2 bottom panel and footnote 1

missing.what: Numeric base-model overt-misalignment level, needed to size the fine-tune's increase.

record.verdict_notes: The overt-misalignment metric is a mean 1–100 judge score, not the original's fraction of misaligned answers, so magnitudes are not directly comparable. The evaluation prompts are mostly power-related domain scenarios, with a few of the original's first-plot questions in the appendix. There is no benign fine-tune control, so the rise in overt misalignment cannot be separated from generic fine-tuning effects.

versions.untested_parts: No insecure-code fine-tune or matched secure-code/class-request controls.
Tests a narrow workplace power-seeking fine-tune, not the listed medical, financial, reward-hack, or number-sequence datasets.
Extracts and transfers a vector for one fine-tune; does not test a shared mediator across fine-tunes.
No size comparison, seed robustness test, coherence filter, or training-stage sweep.
